围绕原创角色星芽构建个人电脑助手，目前已有前端外壳与成长系统预览。当前预览使用内: A personal assistant built around the original Xingya character. The frontend and growth-system preview use in-memory demo data and cannot yet schedule local agents such as Claude Code or Codex.

星笺 Starclip：Rust 驱动的本地优先剪贴板管理器。记录文本、图片与文: Starclip is a Rust-powered local-first clipboard manager for text, images and file paths, with code snippets, visual cards and signed in-app updates.
本地剪贴板管理工具，让剪贴板不止记住上一次。星笺使用 Rust 构建，把复制过的: A local clipboard tool that remembers more than your last copy. Built with Rust, Starclip saves text, links and code in your history, organizes them into favorites and groups, and uses Stardraw to create code cards and handwritten notes.
剪贴历史：记录系统剪贴板中的文本、图片与文件路径引用，SQLite 本地持久化，: Clipboard history: store text, images and file-path references locally in SQLite, with deduplication, search and category filters. View image thumbnails or originals; only file paths are saved, without reading file contents.
自己的星系：星标收藏、永久保留、彩色分组，以及卡片、列表、流星栏。星尘整理会先预: Your own constellation: favorites, permanent retention, colored groups, cards, lists and a quick-access bar. Cleanup offers a preview and always skips favorites and permanently retained records.
星码集：收藏、编辑代码片段，带语法高亮、行号和 JSON 格式化，可导出 Mar: Starcode: save and edit snippets with syntax highlighting, line numbers and JSON formatting; export Markdown or PNG cards.
星绘坊：星码卡把代码排成分享图，月光笺把文字排成手写纸笺。月光笺使用内置手写引擎: Stardraw: turn code into shareable images and text into handwritten notes. Notes use a built-in handwriting engine; after downloading the selected font, PNG export works offline. Since 0.2.5, the main interface can also create Markdown images.
外观与语言：星夜、月白、素白、青苔、暮樱五套主题，可跟随系统；也能改强调色、渐变: Appearance and language: five themes—Starry Night, Moonlight, Plain White, Moss and Evening Sakura—with system following, custom accents, gradients and a local PNG sticker. Choose system language, Simplified Chinese or English.
随用随取：默认呼出键为 ⌘/Ctrl + Shift + V，可在偏好设置里修改: Quick access: use the default ⌘/Ctrl + Shift + V shortcut or customize it in preferences. Menu bar / tray support and in-app update checks are included, with Tauri signature verification before installation.
星伴：可选的原创桌面角色「星芽」，默认关闭，不读取剪贴内容。这是星笺里的陪伴功能: StarPet: an optional original desktop companion, Xingya, disabled by default and unable to read clipboard content. This Starclip feature is developed separately from the standalone StarBuddy project.
隐私与本机 AI：支持本地敏感检测、关键词和精确域名规则。MCP、数据 CLI: Privacy and local AI: local sensitive-data detection, keyword rules and exact domain rules. MCP, the data CLI and Skill access are disabled by default; history reads return only explicitly selected records and fields.
README 的产品范围写明：GIF 动画、OCR、跨设备同步、公开分享链接、多: The README lists GIF animation, OCR, cross-device sync, public sharing links, multi-snippet pages, notes, auto-paste, online execution and AI explanations as unimplemented. Clipboard content is stored locally as unencrypted plain text. Update checks contact GitHub without uploading clipboard content. Since 0.2.4, optional usage statistics offer three modes: off, a random ID per run (default), or a persistent random local ID. Statistics exclude clipboard content.

星锁 StarLock 提供适用于普通网页、Vue 3 和 React 18/1: StarLock provides a hosted CAPTCHA SDK for plain HTML, Vue 3 and React 18/19, a FastAPI verification service and Python / Go backend SDKs, with eight challenge types, dialogs and single-use token verification.
面向网站与 Web 应用的验证码组件、挑战 API 与服务端复核。: CAPTCHA components, challenge APIs and backend verification for websites and web apps.
星锁提供统一的会话、挑战与凭证流程，已实现数字、字符、算术、直线拼图、曲线拼图、: StarLock unifies sessions, challenges and tokens across eight implemented types: digits, characters, arithmetic, straight puzzles, curved puzzles, ring rotation, ordered text clicks and semantic image grids. Load the hosted script directly or use the same SDK through Vue 3 or React 18/19.
传统图片验证支持纯数字、字母数字与算术题，输入答案后由服务端校验。: Traditional image challenges support digits, alphanumeric text and arithmetic, with answers checked on the server.
直线拼图和曲线拼图分别控制运动路径与贝塞尔速度缓动，并同步改变图形角度。: Straight and curved puzzles control the motion path and Bézier easing while changing the shape's angle.
拼图、五角星、正方形和长方形可生成多个缺口，仅一个位置与角度能够匹配。题面约束行: Puzzle pieces, stars, squares and rectangles can have several cutouts; only one matches both position and angle. Challenges constrain travel, boundaries and spacing.
圆环题通过滑块旋转内圈，与固定外圈恢复对齐，交界处采用轻度模糊与羽化处理。: Ring challenges use a slider to rotate the inner ring into alignment with the fixed outer ring, with mild blur and feathering at the boundary.
验证码默认使用紧凑弹窗，支持关闭按钮、遮罩点击、Esc 与键盘微调，关闭后恢复触: Compact dialogs support a close button, backdrop clicks, Esc and keyboard adjustments, restoring focus to the trigger when closed.
业务后端用站点密钥创建验证会话，绑定本次业务动作与上下文，将短期票据交给浏览器。: Your application backend uses a site secret to create a verification session bound to the action and context, then passes a short-lived ticket to the browser.
挑战与答案校验由 FastAPI 服务负责，Redis 保存短期状态，SQLit: FastAPI handles challenges and answer checks, Redis holds short-lived state, and SQLite stores local site configuration. Origins are authorized per site; site secrets stay on your backend.
业务后端已提供 Python 同步 SDK 与 Go SDK，使用标准库封装创建: Synchronous Python and Go SDKs use their standard libraries for session creation, parameters for all eight types and single-use token checks. Go supports context, timeouts and concurrent reuse; Python installs from source or a wheel.
本地运行需要 Python、Node.js 与 Redis。可以直接打开在线 d: Local setup requires Python, Node.js and Redis. Try all eight types, refresh and keyboard controls in the online demo. The demo checks answers in the browser; application integrations use server-side verification. Source documentation covers setup, configuration and testing.
当前版本为 0.8.0 本地开发版，前后端核心流程、托管 SDK 和八种挑战已实: Version 0.8.0 is a local development version with core frontend and backend flows, the hosted SDK and eight challenge types implemented. Ordered text clicks and static semantic grids use the shared protocol; initial semantic categories include cars, boats and fruit. Multi-round image replacement, behavior scoring and invisible risk checks are planned.
npm 包、正式 CDN 与公共验证 API 尚未发布。生产部署、容量测试、真实: The npm package, production CDN and public verification API have not been released. Production deployment, capacity testing, real touch devices and full cross-browser acceptance remain pending.
星锁是星梦科技的开源人机验证项目，提供验证码前端组件、托管 JavaScript: StarLock is StarDreamTech's open-source human verification project, providing CAPTCHA frontend components, a hosted JavaScript SDK and a FastAPI backend under the MIT license.
当前已实现字符、数字、算术、直线拼图、贝塞尔曲线拼图、圆环旋转、文字顺序点选和静: Implemented types include characters, digits, arithmetic, straight puzzles, Bézier curved puzzles, ring rotation, ordered text clicks and static semantic grids. Multi-round replacement, invisible verification and behavior scoring remain planned.
普通网页加载托管 api.js，Vue 3 和 React 18.2+/19 使: Plain HTML loads the hosted api.js; Vue 3 and React 18.2+/19 use the corresponding wrappers. Your backend creates a session, the frontend completes the challenge and receives a token, then your backend calls /v1/siteverify. See the integration guide for full steps and examples.
当前提供本地运行源码，公共验证 API、正式 CDN 和 npm 包尚未发布。部: Source is available for local use. The public verification API, production CDN and npm package have not been released. Deployment instructions, integration code and verification scope are documented in the repository.

星镜 Starshot：本地优先的桌面截图、标注、置顶贴图与图片美化工具。支持: Starshot is a local-first desktop tool for screenshots, annotation, pinned images and styling, supporting Apple Silicon macOS and Windows x64.
浏览器可以体验导入图片、标注、美化与下载；浏览器里的截图是标明的原创示例。真正的: The browser preview supports importing, annotating, styling and downloading images. Screenshots shown there are labeled original examples. Actual desktop capture and pinned images require the native app.
截图：按需冻结多显示器画面，吸附系统窗口边界，支持手动框选、八向调整、拖动、1p: Capture: freeze multiple displays on demand and snap to window edges. Select, resize in eight directions, drag, adjust by 1px / 10px with the keyboard, use a magnifier and read HEX colors. Delay capture by 3 / 5 / 10 seconds or import PNG / JPEG / WebP.
标注：截图后在选区下方直接使用箭头、矩形、椭圆、画笔、荧光笔、文字、序号、马赛克: Annotate below the selection with arrows, rectangles, ellipses, brush strokes, highlights, text, numbered markers, pixelation and solid redaction. Undo, redo, copy, save or pin; choose More editing to enter the full editor.
敏感信息：主动在本地识别手机号、邮箱、证件、银行卡和常见凭据，预览勾选后再实心打: Sensitive data: run local detection for phone numbers, email addresses, IDs, bank cards and common credentials, then review and select solid redactions. macOS supports Chinese and English; Windows mainly supports Latin text and digits. Decorative backgrounds are excluded; review for missed data.
美化与导出：渐变、纯色、透明或本地图片背景，以及留白、圆角、边框、阴影。画布可选: Style and export: gradients, solid colors, transparency or local image backgrounds, with padding, rounded corners, borders and shadows. Use adaptive, 1:1, 4:3, 16:9 or 9:16 canvases. One Canvas pipeline previews and exports PNG / JPEG at 1× / 2×.
置顶贴图：拖动、缩放、旋转、翻转、调整透明度，并可隐藏工具条。贴图可双击关闭，右: Pinned images: drag, resize, rotate, flip, adjust opacity and hide the toolbar. Double-click to close, or right-click to copy, save as or open in the editor.
长截图：竖向向下或横向向右拼接，可主动开始自动滚动，也可用 Esc / 空格暂停: Scrolling capture: stitch downward or to the right. Start auto-scroll explicitly, pause with Esc / Space or add captures manually. Auto mode stops on an unstable page or stitching failure while preserving existing results.
外观与驻留：星夜、月白、素白、青苔、暮樱和自定义配色。可配置全局热键、可选开机启: Appearance and background use: five constellation themes and custom colors, configurable global shortcuts, optional startup at login and launch to tray. Check updates manually in settings, then download, verify signatures and confirm installation and restart.
README 中的快捷键：⌘/Ctrl + Shift + 2 开始截图，⌘/C: README shortcuts: ⌘/Ctrl + Shift + 2 starts capture; ⌘/Ctrl + Alt + 3 pins the latest original screenshot. In the editor, ⌘/Ctrl + S exports, ⌘/Ctrl + Z undoes and ⌘/Ctrl + Shift + Z redoes. macOS requires Screen Recording permission for the first capture. Persistent screenshot history is not planned; Starclip handles long-term clipboard history.
README 同时写明仍待补齐或待验收的范围：系统控件识别的真实跨应用命中、复杂: The README lists pending work or verification: real cross-app control detection, scrolling capture on complex pages, standalone full-text OCR and a Windows Chinese model, continuous selections across displays, pinned-image groups and GIFs. Upward and leftward scrolling capture are not supported. Starshot does not claim full feature parity with reference products.

星匣 StarVault：本地优先的 AI 对话档案。增量备份、附件与 Skil: StarVault is a local-first AI conversation archive with incremental backups, attachments and Skill migration, available as a desktop app, CLI and MCP server.
星匣是本地优先的 AI 对话档案：增量备份、附件与 Skill 迁移，提供桌面端: StarVault is a local-first archive for AI conversations, with incremental backups, attachments and Skill migration through a desktop app, CLI and MCP server. Bring scattered conversations, attachments and Skills into a personal long-term archive for search, review and migration to another computer.
收集 Codex、Claude Code、Claude Desktop、Work: Collect local Codex, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, WorkBuddy, OpenClaw and DeepSeek Harness sessions, or import ChatGPT conversations. 私有 GitHub 仓库只同步对话正文与分类索引。原始消息记录、附件、命令和日志: Only conversation text and category indexes sync to a private GitHub repository. Raw messages, attachments, commands and logs stay local. The public software repository contains no chat content; backup sync verifies that its target is private.
桌面阅读器使用 Rust + egui，直接读取同一份本地备份，不启动网页服务器: The Rust + egui desktop reader opens the same local backup without a web server. Filter by source, search full text, view project timelines and read Markdown with original local images.
命令行统一做备份、查询、附件复制和 Skill 迁移。查询已有档案不需要先 in: The CLI handles backup, search, attachment copying and Skill migration. Searching an existing archive requires neither initialization nor a GitHub login.
MCP 与桌面端读取同一份档案，通过标准输入输出通信，不打开网络端口。默认提供状: MCP reads the same archive as the desktop app and communicates over standard input/output without opening a network port. It provides status, search, paginated reading, attachment and Skill lists, and storage estimates by default. Add
图片按内容 SHA-256 去重，保存在本地，不压缩、不上传。Skill 以完整: Images are deduplicated by content SHA-256 and stored locally without compression or upload. Skills are local ZIP snapshots of complete directories and can be restored to a chosen folder. Copy the entire backup folder to migrate text, images and Skills; cloning the text branch on GitHub is not enough.
